mapper.select: SELECT id, employee_id AS employeeId, field_name AS fieldName, old_value AS oldValue, new_value AS newValue, effective_date AS effectiveDate, reason, operator_id AS operatorId, created_at AS createdAt FROM employee_salary_history WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY effective_date DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_salary_history (employee_id, field_name, old_value, new_value, effective_date, reason, operator_id) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{fieldName}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, #{effectiveDate}, #{reason}, #{operatorId})
